summary: Successfully implemented KAFKA-20444 (KIP-1319) by modifying KafkaProducer.sendOffsetsToTransaction() to ensure topic IDs are available in the metadata cache before sending TxnOffsetCommit requests. Added ensureTopicMetadataIncludingIds() method that triggers metadata refresh when topic IDs are missing, enabling v6+ protocol negotiation. Both required tests now pass: testSendOffsetsToTransactionNegotiatesV6WhenMetadataKnowsTopicId and testSendOffsetsToTransactionTriggersMetadataRefreshThenNegotiatesV6. All existing KafkaProducerTest tests continue to pass.
